sense.text:
“For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.” This is the political power under darkness. Our war is not flesh and blood; it is spiritual wickedness in high places.

Many of us underestimate what America really is, and how deep the rabbit hole goes in this place. The rulers of the darkness of this world sit in its high places, and the scriptures that follow show who they are.

Even their movies are part of it. They are not made to entertain us; they are propaganda, made to brainwash our men, our wives and our children. The brothers especially, as the leaders, have to stop watching them for entertainment and look at them with a spiritual eye.

precepts.why:
“As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” Our people watched for a nation, America, to save them, and in 2025 we are still thinking this place is for us. That was vain help.

The system was never built for us. When the system was built, we were in slavery, so that same system was never going to benefit us; it was always written against the slaves. Donald Trump is forcing the negro to see the system for exactly what it is.

That is why we wrestle against the rulers of the darkness of this world: the nation we watched for is one of the high places of that darkness, and it cannot save us.

“They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.” A people that could not profit them, that could not help: that is what our people leaned on.

Read with Lamentations 4:17, it is the same lesson. The nation we watched for and trusted in is no help and no profit to us. In the end it is only a shame and a reproach.

“This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.”

The Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and look at who he has set up over it now: “the basest of men.” These people ruling are the bottom of the bottom line.

God put them in that position to check us, because some of our people were evil as hell. Keep that in mind: the rulers of the darkness of this world are the basest of men, set over the kingdom by the Most High himself.

“Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee, whom the Lord thy God shall choose: one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee.” This is a law; this is what God said. Any man set over us, God has to choose that man, and he has to be one from among our brethren, another Israelite.

Yet some of our people, house negroes, give their whole heart to the rulers of this place. Officer Tatum calls the so-called Jews, who are Amalek, the people chosen by God, and cheers on the killing in Gaza, where over 200,000 Palestinians and tens of thousands of children have been killed; those are the same people who killed the black leaders. That is the house negro: when he found out what the slaves planned, he went and told the master exactly what they were about to do. Nicki Minaj, with millions of followers, the kind of hoe some of our daughters look at as a role model and a spokesperson for the black community, stands up at Turning Point USA's America Fest and calls him "our president." She forgot how she got here: she did not come voluntarily, but in a slave ship, shackled with chains, while millions of our forefathers and foremothers died. These negroes get a couple of dollars and forget who the white man is, and they see nothing wrong with TPUSA, when Charlie Kirk was one of the most racist bastards. She is a washed-up hoe in her 40s trying to rebrand herself as a faithful Christian, and the way she rebrands is to go with the Republicans. That is what hoes do: after they have whored themselves, they go to the church.

Those are white people in black skin, and there are thousands, maybe millions of them in the black community. They will come against us in these last days and help the enemy put the prophets to death. Stop thinking you have a magic scripture for them; their fate is sealed. They can only do two things: repent or die. Donald Trump is going to give these negroes a wake-up call. And whether it is Republican or Democrat, it does not matter: it is the same beast.

sense.text:
“Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.” There is a reason God said not to make marriages with these people: do not give your daughters to their sons, and do not take their daughters for your sons.

Venus Williams married an Italian, and the Italians are the most racist people on this planet; do your history. Her father Richard put his life on the line for his black daughters to enter a space no one wanted them in, in the '90s; he protected them, provided for them and fought for them, and they married the same enemy their father fought against. The greatest honor a daughter can do her father is to bring home a man who honors him. Instead they spit in his face, and he did not attend either ceremony.

That white man would never have married her if she were broke. She is worth around a hundred million dollars; who do you think paid for the wedding and the big house? This is the same man who raped them, killed and whipped their fathers in front of them, and abused their children, and today they marry him voluntarily, while black women online say they are happy for her. Nobody respects the black man. Remember what the white man did to Halle Berry: he left her and made sure she paid. He will do the same thing.

“For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods.” That is the reason behind the law: they will turn your son away from following the Most High, so that he serves their gods. Their God is not our God.

precepts.why:
“Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you: Know for a certainty that the Lord your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you.”

Even when we took the land, there was a remnant of these nations in the midst of us. Our forefather Joshua warned us: if you go back and marry these nations, know for sure God is not going to get rid of them.

So we were warned to stay away from these people, because their God is not our God. But we did exactly what we were warned not to do.

“Judah hath dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the Lord which he loved, and hath married the daughter of a strange god.” Judah profaned the holiness of the Lord by marrying the daughter of a strange god, and it was not only Judah; the whole twelve tribes did it.

This is spiritual. The ones who marry into that nation take on a different spirit, the beast spirit. Look at Serena Williams today: bleached, bugged out, looking crazy because of that beast. We are not supposed to mix the warrior seed, the royal seed, with that beast, with pig seed.

That is the abomination God was warning about in Deuteronomy 7: it is called lust, and all of it is lust, and eventually the lust fades away.

sense.text:
“And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.” This other beast is America.

The two horns are the Republicans and the Democrats. It does not matter which one: they are the same beast, speaking as a dragon.

“And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him.” The first beast is Rome. America exercises all the power of Rome because America follows everything Rome did: the senators, the congressmen, the same system with only the names changed. America is the extension of Rome.
“And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.” God said he hates Esau, and Esau is the white man.

“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places.” Edom said it would rise again and build: that is the rebirth, the Renaissance. “They shall build, but I will throw down”: the throwing down is what they call the Dark Ages.

“And they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” Keep that word in mind through the whole lesson: the people. A lot of us think they are not all the same. They are all the same, from the little baby to the oldest. The only difference is that some of them show it more than others; but every single one of them hates your guts, because they are all the sons of Edom. Edomites, the same people. He is talking about all of Edom.

precepts.why:
“But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?” Esau is the wicked, the same one we just read about in Malachi.

So Esau has no business opening the Bible at all. That is why an Israelite has no reason to go into a debate with Esau over the scriptures. We teach that Esau is not going to get the kingdom; why would we debate him over John 3:16 to prove to him that he will? Do not be concerned with Esau. He is not even supposed to take the covenant in his mouth.

sense.text:
“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” Esau weakens the nations, through the economy, through political power and through military power.

Look at what Donald Trump is doing in Venezuela and in Africa right now: weakening the nations. They claimed Venezuela was about stopping drug trafficking, yet Mexico, on the border of America, has more drug cartels than any place in the world and they are not bombing Mexico. Then Trump said it plainly: they want the oil, as if Venezuela ever stole oil or land from America. The masses are asses; the rich think they can tell the poor anything and they will believe it, and our people believe it.

On Christmas Day the US bombed Nigeria, claiming it was to protect Christians from persecution. To sell it to a black nation they put up a black face, the same way they used Colin Powell to lie about weapons of mass destruction before Iraq. Out of all our lawyers, doctors, engineers and politicians, they picked a hoe, Nicki Minaj, to thank Trump for defending Christians in Nigeria. That is the ultimate disrespect to black people. Meanwhile the so-called Jews they back say they spit on the ground at a crucifix, call for Christians to be killed, and spit in a Christian woman's face in the street of Jerusalem. That is the hypocrisy: they want the oil, and they are the evil seed, the sons of the devil. All of them are devils. Do not look at a little baby and say it is innocent; that little baby is a demon. From the little baby all the way up, they are all sons of the devil, the seed of evildoers.

precepts.why:
“Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” This is what God said: never trust our enemy.

His wickedness is like rust on iron: it does not leave. So when he says he is going into Nigeria to defend Christians, or into Venezuela to stop drugs, we do not believe him. They are not fooling us.

“Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.” That is Esau for you. In his sleep he is thinking about what evil he is going to do when he wakes up, and when he gets up he practises the same thing he was thinking last night, because it is in the power of his hand. That is how the plan was laid: steal the oil in Nigeria, say it is to defend Christians, and find the biggest hoe with millions of followers, one dumb black people will believe, because if white men go in alone they will be called racist.

“And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” They covet fields: the oil in Nigeria and Venezuela, the diamonds and copper in all the African countries. America was built by violence; this is stolen land, and millions of indigenous people died for it. After they killed, murdered and raped, they built churches and said John 3:16. They killed the black leaders in Africa by violence. This place has always been about darkness.

They oppress a man and his heritage. Even after so-called slavery was over, here in Georgia they stole our people's land; the history of Forsyth and of the lake up there shows it. Now they stand up talking about protecting Christians.

“Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not.” Esau has oppressed, and we are the poor he oppressed.

He violently takes houses he did not build. He took this place by violence; when he divided Africa he took it by violence, and King Leopold killed millions of our people. Europe is beautiful because of money from the continent where millions of us died. In 2025 they are still killing millions of us: the war in Sudan, the Congo, where millions die for what goes into the iPhone in your hand. They are like a man who throws a rock and hides his hand, then offers to help find who threw it. They say it is black people killing black people, but black people do not make the weapons; the guns in Haiti come from the United States.

In the South they drove whole black communities out of places like Forsyth, Georgia and Lake Lanier and took the houses and businesses they never worked for, and they are still taking our people's land today. Every September 11 they want a moment of silence, but when it is millions of our people they say it was a long time ago.

sense.text:
“For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them.” People are calling Donald Trump a president of peace. Under the so-called peace in Gaza, Amalek has killed over 400 Palestinians and the media does not cover it. In his first months he oversaw nearly as many air strikes as the entire previous administration did in four years. He tells the people of Sudan and Haiti to go back to their countries, when they are the ones who destabilized those countries so the people could not stay there.

Do not believe in that peace. There is no peace. What is going on now will only get worse and worse, and we pray for it to escalate, because in all this destruction, killing and bloodshed our salvation comes. Ask the Most High to strengthen your spirit, your brothers and your sisters, so we can stand still and wait.

This is not our fight. Civil wars will happen; do not get involved in anybody's foolishness or get distracted. Stay in the scriptures: that is your war. We pray the Most High preserves the Afro-Palestinians, but the Arabs did some of the most horrible things to our people, and we only care about the Israelites.

precepts.why:
“Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities. For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the Lord.”

Nobody is innocent. Whatever evil was done to the Israelites, no one is getting away with it. Slaughter is prepared for the children for the sin of their fathers, because they are their fathers.

Cut off means God is going to kill all of them. When Esau falls, he will never rise again. Some think Esau will never fall, but Babylon, the Medes and Persians, the Greeks, Rome and Egypt were all superpowers in their time, and they fell. America has the most powerful military on the planet, bombs and lasers, but the Most High is more powerful than America.

“Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.” The smith in those days is what we call scientists today, the ones who make weapons.

The waster is nuclear power. God let him create the waster to destroy. That is the sudden destruction that comes when they say peace and safety.

sense.text: “And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.” Him is Christ. The devil showed Christ all the great kingdoms: America, Russia, China, France, Germany, Europe. This answers how Esau got all this power.

“All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.” Satan told Christ that all this power and the glory of these kingdoms was delivered to him, so he could give it to whoever he wants.

“If thou therefore wilt worship me”, he said. Christ answered, “Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.”

Satan tried to give Christ what already belonged to Christ, and Christ said no: he worships God only. It is the same today.

precepts.why:
“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?” The earth was given into the hand of the wicked.

We are the judges of the earth; the scripture says the earth was created for the Israelites, so it belongs to us. Esau covers the faces of the judges. Just as Satan tried to give Christ what belonged to Christ, Esau tries to give us what belongs to us, and some of us fall for it.

“If not, where, and who is he?” If the white man is not the devil, show me who is. The most evil things on this earth were caused by the white man; you want peace on earth, get rid of the white man. The so-called American Indians had peace in this land, and Africa had peace, before the white man docked his boat; he brought disease, rape, murder and stealing. This is what Malachi chapter 1 is talking about: everywhere you see evil, move the curtain and the white man is right there.

“Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth, That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?” Triumphing is victory. The victory of the wicked is short.

America is the biggest hypocrite on the planet, and the joy of the hypocrite is but for a moment. The power delivered to the wicked is temporary; there is going to be an end to it. All we have to do is be patient and wait.

sense.text: “They shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.” This is for the negroes married to them, for Serena and Venus Williams: every one shall turn to his own people.

“Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.” Everyone found married to these demons, with kids by them, shall be thrust through. Everyone joined unto them shall die. That is what God says.

A lot of our people are going to fall into this, two out of three: that is the two-thirds. Even some in the truth right now will get caught up in it, because they still have the mindset that they are missing something. Do not feel sorry for them; their fate is sealed.

“He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.” The iron weapon is the missile. This goes with Isaiah 54:16, the smith and the waster: the weapons of destruction coming upon the wicked.

“Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed.” A decree is a mandate: passing laws, writing legislation.

That is why black people cannot be racist. To be racist you have to have the power to sign laws that affect a whole people, the way Donald Trump passes laws to deport the people from Sudan and Haiti. We do not have the power to pass laws affecting white people, or even ourselves. The only law the so-called black president Obama passed was a homosexual law; none benefited black people.

“To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!” We are the needy. We are the poor whose right they take away. We are the fatherless. We are the oppressed, and we are still being oppressed.

This is the prophecy of what is going to happen to America, for the dumb Christians who think America will last forever. “Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire”: that fire is nuclear destruction, and that is what is coming here. “For strong is the Lord God who judgeth her”: judgment is coming to this place.

“And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning.” They lived deliciously with her because every country in the world trades with America; America is the biggest consumer on the earth.

“Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” This is not the old Babylon, because the old Babylon was never burned down. This is talking about America.

“And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed.” God is raising up his kingdom right now. These men, us, are the kingdom being built. Some look and say it is only a few of us, but nobody can stop it.

“And the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.” When we take over and start ruling, that nation will never rise up again, and nobody will be able to stand before us, because we are going to have power. That is not now. Right now God is starting the wisdom of the kingdom: we are repenting and knowing who we are, Judah, Benjamin, Levi, Ephraim, Simeon; coming out of the filthy Christian church; stopping the smoking, the stealing, the adultery and whoremongering.

In the middle of waking up you are going to make mistakes. When you do, do not stay down. Satan will make you believe you are no good. Get up, repent and keep moving, because you are the chosen, the righteous. This world is darkness and we are the light of this world; do not turn that light off and go back to darkness, which has nothing to offer you but death.

precepts.why:
“But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.” We are the lost sheep. Christ only came for us; he only died for the Israelites, to redeem us back to the Father.

So never think we are not special. The kingdom God is setting up is for the lost sheep he sent his Son to bring back.

sense.text:
“And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations.” You must overcome: your personal sin, the sin of America, whatever you are fighting, drug addiction, alcohol, women or men. If you want the kingdom of heaven, there is no two ways about it. Keep his works, his laws, unto the end; and the end is either you die in this, or Christ comes back while you are alive.

To him will he give power. We want that power, to rule the other nations and break them just as they broke us. But we must wait for that spiritual power and have faith. Now is not the time to pick up knives and guns; a gun or a knife can do nothing but get you killed.
“And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers.” We are not going to play with the nations.

precepts.why:
“Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.” That is the nuclear weapon. Then: “No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper.” Think about it: Esau shoots a nuclear weapon and you walk right through it. That is what power means.

Can weapons prosper against us today? Yes. That is why we must wait for that power.

“And every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn.” Every tongue: in that day let anybody dare to call us out of our name. “This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord.” We are the servants; this is our heritage, and our righteousness is of the Most High.

“Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day.” The arrow is the missile. “Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.”

“A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand.” A gun cannot do that; that is nuclear destruction, and it will not touch you. Ten thousand people drop dead and you stand there and nothing can affect you. That is the power promised to him that overcometh.

“But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.” The saints of the Most High are us.

We are not going to ask anybody for the kingdom or ask permission. We are going to take it and possess it for ever and ever.
“Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.” This is how we are going to rule when we take the kingdom: in righteousness.

“Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.” We are the kings, and we are the judges of the earth. Right now we look like a bunch of nobodies, but the scripture says the earth was created for us, so we are its judges.

“Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.”

“For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder.” That is Christ. His name is called “Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.”

“Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end.” Christ's government has no end; we are going to take the kingdom forever, “upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.”

“How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.” There was a time we were righteous and had righteousness among us. What happened to us? Now we kill each other like it is nothing. The princes are rebellious and “companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless.”

Then the Lord says, “I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies,” and “I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness.” Little by little we are waking up, and the brothers shown on the screen are those judges; the Most High is restoring them now.

The Most High is going to restore us again, and we are going to be called the city of righteousness.
